<think>**Optimizing bill-state logic**

**Implementing registered bill logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module ticket_machine #(
    parameter ON  = 1'b1,
    parameter OFF = 1'b0
) (
    input  clk, clear, ten, twenty,
    output reg ready, dispense, return_sig, bill
);

    reg s_ready, s_disp, s_return;
    reg s_bill10, s_bill20, s_bill30;

    wire take_twenty = twenty & ~ten;
    wire idle_input  = ~(ten | twenty);
    wire accept_bill = ten | twenty;

    // Explicit one-hot transitions retain ten's priority over twenty.
    // All state and output storage uses the same synchronous reset.
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (clear) begin
            s_ready  <= 1'b1;
            s_disp   <= 1'b0;
            s_return <= 1'b0;
            s_bill10 <= 1'b0;
            s_bill20 <= 1'b0;
            s_bill30 <= 1'b0;
            bill     <= OFF;
        end else begin
            s_ready <= s_disp | s_return | (s_ready & idle_input);
            s_disp <= (s_bill20 & take_twenty) | (s_bill30 & ten);
            s_return <= s_bill30 & take_twenty;
            s_bill10 <= (s_ready & ten) | (s_bill10 & idle_input);
            s_bill20 <= (s_ready & take_twenty)
                      | (s_bill10 & ten)
                      | (s_bill20 & idle_input);
            s_bill30 <= (s_bill10 & take_twenty)
                      | (s_bill20 & ten)
                      | (s_bill30 & idle_input);

            // This is the bill indication of the state being entered,
            // not a delayed copy of the current state's bill indication.
            bill <= ((s_ready & accept_bill)
                   | s_bill10
                   | (s_bill20 & ~take_twenty)
                   | (s_bill30 & idle_input)) ? ON : OFF;
        end
    end

    always @* begin
        ready      = s_ready  ? ON : OFF;
        dispense   = s_disp   ? ON : OFF;
        return_sig = s_return ? ON : OFF;
    end

endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The measured worst path is a state flip-flop through a three-input OR to bill. This removes the current-state three-way OR from the bill output path without adding an output cycle. The three other outputs remain direct indications of their corresponding state bits.",

The added bill-register input logic or changed state mapping could become critical; synthesis and STA must establish strictly better WNS and non-regressing TNS.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds one flip-flop for bill and its next-value logic. Explicit transition equations may offset some of that cost, but the net mapped area is unknown. Reject this candidate if mapped area exceeds 278.01664000000005 um^2 or if timing acceptance fails.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface, parameter declarations and defaults, synchronous active-high clear, single positive-edge clock, and output latency. Simultaneous ten and twenty selects ten. Every clear assertion returns the state to ready and sets bill to OFF on that edge. The fixed startup reset establishes the one-hot invariant; no additional startup or input assumptions are introduced. Illegal internal state recovery is not matched outside reset-reachable behavior. Equivalence must be checked against the frozen original with the supplied startup contract; no formal or EDA result is claimed."
